# IronPulse — Implementation Tasks

## Template Info

- **Name:** IronPulse
- **Original:** ColorLib Crossbody (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/crossbody/)
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/crossbody/
- **Type:** Crossfit & Fitness landing page

## Sections to Implement (in order)

1. [ ] Scaffold: package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/index.css, src/test/setup.ts
2. [ ] SocialIcons — TwitterIcon, FacebookIcon, InstagramIcon (inline SVGs)
3. [ ] Navbar — fixed dark top bar, brand, nav links, mobile hamburger
4. [ ] Hero — fullscreen bg image, overlay, headline, subtitle, play button
5. [ ] Pricing — 3 cards with bg images, prices, CTA buttons
6. [ ] Programs — split layout, icon list, image
7. [ ] StatsCounter — dark bg, 4 stat counters
8. [ ] Coaches — 4 coach cards with social icons
9. [ ] Testimonials — dark bg, 3 testimonial cards
10. [ ] Blog — 3 blog cards with meta
11. [ ] ContactForm — map placeholder + form
12. [ ] Gallery — 4-image grid with hover overlay
13. [ ] Footer — 4-column dark footer, Component Dock link
14. [ ] App.tsx — compose all sections
15. [ ] Tests — one .test.tsx per component
16. [ ] public/CNAME — ironpulse.free.componentdock.com

## Design Tokens

- Brand: #78d5ef (cyan)
- Accent: #e5ce48 (yellow/gold)
- Dark: #141414, Darker: #0d0d0d
- Font: Work Sans (Google Fonts)
- Body text: #212529, Muted: #6c757d

## Notes

- Based on ColorLib "Crossbody" which is a crossfit/gym website
- Very similar structure to existing Piston (Bodyfit) template
- Reuses piston's exact component patterns
- All images via picsum.photos seeded placeholders
- Brand icons (Twitter/Facebook/Instagram) as inline SVGs
